feature.name: Recurring invoice templates
feature.description: Let users save invoice layouts and auto-send on a schedule to repeat clients, with gentle payment reminders.

executiveSummary: LedgerLite's recurring invoice templates feature enters a market where FreshBooks is the most direct competitor with recent debt financing ($125M in 2025) but declining headcount (-10.09% YoY). Zoho offers a vast, profitable suite with 30,944 employees, while Wave's data is unreliable but appears as a competitor in FreshBooks' paid SEO. The feature is table stakes; differentiation lies in simplicity, mobile-first UX, and gentle reminders tailored to freelancers like Maya and Omar. Key risks include competitor bundling and lack of direct feature usage data.
